data.name: HardwareUpTo
data.value: This PC's graphics hardware exports up to {0}.
data.comment: {0}: the largest resolution, such as "1440p". Every size up to it uses the graphics hardware.

data.name: HardwareUpToThenSoftware
data.value: This PC's graphics hardware exports up to {0}; larger sizes use the slower software encoder.
data.comment: {0}: the largest resolution the hardware takes; larger ones work, slower, in software.

data.name: SoftwareOnly
data.value: This PC's graphics hardware cannot encode {0}; the slower software encoder exports up to {1}.
data.comment: {0}: the codec, such as "H.264"; {1}: the largest resolution the software encoder takes.

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: This PC cannot export {0} video at this shape and frame rate.

data.name: NoPlayback
data.value: This PC cannot play {0} video, so it does not export it.
data.comment: {0}: the codec, "HEVC": Windows has no decoder for it (the HEVC Video Extensions are not installed).
